form.draftedToast: Blueprint drafted — {{areas}} knowledge areas across {{sections}} sections.
form.title: Blueprint a role
form.description: Draft the taxonomy of what a role knows — the map an expert interview should cover. Start from a title, an uploaded job description, or a saved role. You review and edit it before anything is saved.
form.savedRoleHint: Pick a role you've already blueprinted to view it and start a capture, or leave it to draft a new one below.
form.uploadHint: Drop in a job description or role charter — we read the text into the context below and guess the title. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
form.seedNone: Start from a role title instead
form.seedHint: Pick a role blueprint to seed the map from its role knowledge — Maven then enriches it.
form.roleTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Senior Wastewater Treatment Operator, or CIO
form.contextPlaceholder: Paste a job description, or a few lines on what makes this role hard to hand over. (An uploaded file fills this in.)
form.roleShapeHint: The shape decides which of the 8 knowledge sections lead — an executive's tree is judgment and relationships, not a task list.

review.nothingToSave: Nothing to save — add or keep at least one node.
review.summary: {{areas}} knowledge areas across {{sections}} sections · <shape>{{archetype}}</shape> shape · review and edit below, then save.
review.rationale: {{rationale}}. Rename or remove anything — nothing is stored until you save.
review.allRemoved: Every node was removed. Start over to draft a fresh blueprint.

saved.summary: Saved blueprint · {{areas}} knowledge areas. Ready to capture against.
saved.noAreas: This role has no saved knowledge areas.

done.title: Saved “{{role}}”
done.summary: {{areas}} knowledge areas are saved and ready. Here's what to do next.
done.startCaptureHint: Interview an expert against this role — Maven asks, Sage extracts the knowledge.
done.anotherHint: Map out the next role at risk.
done.seeHealthHint: Coverage, freshness, and roles at risk.

blueprint.title: Blueprint a role
blueprint.subtitle: Auto-draft the knowledge map for a role, edit it, and save it — then run a capture against it. This replaces hand-authoring taxonomy nodes one by one.

how.interviewText: Maven interviews the expert, one area at a time.
how.extractText: Sage turns each answer into typed knowledge units.
how.validateText: Units are scored and sent to the Reviewer Console.
how.transferText: Validated knowledge becomes the successor's training.
how.title: How a capture works
how.description: You interview the person who holds the role. What they know becomes validated, reusable training for whoever comes next — and a lasting record of the role.

choose.title: Pick a role to capture
choose.description: Capture runs against a role you've already blueprinted. Choose one below, or blueprint a new role first.
choose.empty: No saved roles yet. Blueprint a role first — it maps the knowledge areas this capture will walk through.

plan.whoDescription: Set this once — it applies to every area you capture in this session.
plan.expertPlaceholder: Name of the person who holds this role
plan.realExpert: This is a real expert (not a practice run)
plan.realExpertHint: Real captures need a consent record on file. Leave off for a practice/volunteer run.
plan.consentIdPlaceholder: The id of the signed consent on file
plan.planDescription: Work through the role's knowledge areas. Capture as many as the expert has time for — you can come back and finish the rest later.
plan.enterWho: Enter who you're capturing above to begin.
plan.finishHint: Capture at least one area to finish.

interview.description: {{role}} · Answer in your own words. Maven follows up on what you say.
interview.questionFailed: Something went wrong getting the next question.
interview.saveHint: Answer at least one question to save this area.

done.title: Capture complete — {{role}}
done.summary: {{units}} captured across {{areas}} and sent for review. Here's what happens next.
done.reviewHint: Confirm, amend, or reject each unit. Validated knowledge is what successors are taught.
done.buildTrainingHint: Turn validated knowledge into a wiring-adapted learning path for the next person.

capture.title: Start a capture
capture.subtitle: Sit the role-holder down with Maven and turn what they know into validated training for whoever comes next.

picker.loadError: We couldn't load the curricula right now. Try again shortly.
picker.empty: No curricula have been published yet.

curriculum.openError: We couldn't open this curriculum. It may have been unpublished — go back and pick another.
curriculum.noModules: This curriculum has no modules yet.
curriculum.clarifyDescription: Tell us what's unclear or out of date. Your note goes to the reviewer for this knowledge.

build.noValidated: This role has no validated knowledge yet. Validate some captured units in the Reviewer Console first.
build.assembleFailed: Couldn't assemble a curriculum from this role's validated knowledge.
build.title: Build a curriculum
build.description: Turn a role's validated knowledge into a wiring-adapted learning path for the next person. Only validated and provisional units are used.
build.noRoles: No roles yet — blueprint and capture a role first, then validate its knowledge.

curriculum.title: Successor curriculum
curriculum.subtitle: Learn the role from captured expertise — and flag anything that's no longer accurate.

dashboard.title: Program Health
dashboard.subtitle: Capture progress, freshness, and knowledge-at-risk across the org.
dashboard.loadError: We couldn't load Program Health right now. Try again shortly.
dashboard.empty: No knowledge-capture activity yet. Once sessions are scheduled, program health will show up here.
dashboard.urgentUncaptured_one: {{count}} urgent role has not been captured yet.
dashboard.urgentUncaptured_other: {{count}} urgent roles have not been captured yet.
dashboard.urgentUncaptured: {{count}} urgent roles have not been captured yet.
dashboard.noAtRisk: No roles currently flagged as at risk.

provenance.loadError: Couldn't load the interview for this unit.
provenance.none: No recorded interview for this unit (it may pre-date turn capture).

contradiction.unitGone: This unit is no longer available.

queue.loadError: We couldn't load the review queue right now. Try again shortly.
queue.empty: All caught up — no units awaiting review.
queue.contradictionsDescription: Two captured units disagree. Keep the one that's right (the other is retired), mark that both are true, or dismiss it if it isn't really a contradiction.
queue.noteDescription: Add a note explaining what needs to change before it can be validated.

intake.horizonError: Must be a whole number of months, 0 or more
intake.riskDescription: Flag a role or expert whose knowledge should be prioritized for capture.
intake.consentRequired: Consent id is required for a real (non-practice) session
intake.sessionDescription: Practice sessions need no consent record. A real expert session does.
intake.practiceHint: On — synthetic practice, no consent record needed. Off — a real expert session.

review.title: Reviewer Console
review.subtitle: Validate captured knowledge and flag at-risk roles for capture.
